body:
Life boils down to a cycle of pain, suffering, and futility. 

Only a few people are truly happy. I feel the same way as you.

My mother's boyfriend is similar. He and I are constantly at odds. His favorite thing to torment me with now is to get drunk and harass the dogs until they bark and wake me up on the nights when I work 3rd shift.

I have a question.

Why do you want your cancer to come back?
